title: Chart theme
shahrivar_policy: Shahrivar — Monetary policy (policy rate vs CPI)

inflation_modern.description: Modern inflation palette: semantic headline/core colors, transparent uniformly-sized signal badges, tighter scale margins.

shahrivar.description: Official inflation template: transparent green target band, six categorised signals (trend/momentum/deviation/volatility/pressure/stability) with transparent uniform badges, 5Y view and tight scale margins.

shahrivar_policy.description: Monetary-policy chart template: official policy rate against headline CPI, same transparent Shahrivar badges and layout, PAS (Economic Future Trend + direction/strength) as the leading badge.

shahrivar_growth.description: Growth chart template: GDP YoY (phosphor green) and annualised QoQ (blue) with small data-point markers, one-row signal strip led by GAS (Growth Action Signal) plus GMI/OGI/GSI/PMI/NOW/GAPg, identical layout and transparency to the other Shahrivar charts.

shahrivar_hist.description: Historical candlestick template: OHLC candles with EMA21 (phosphor green) and SMA50 (blue) overlays, Golden/Death Cross markers, a volume pane underneath, and an eight-badge signal strip in one row — one leading badge, six secondary badges and a double-width warning badge — with the same layout and transparency as the other Shahrivar charts. The time axis uses a fixed 21:00 UTC origin (no DST, no bucket merging) while the source data stays raw UTC.

shahrivar_financial.description: Financial-conditions chart template: composite FCI (bright blue) and the country 10Y yield (standard blue) as line-only series, 3.5-year zoom with one year of future space, and a single-row signal strip led by FAS (Financial Action Signal) plus Y10/Credit/DXY/Equity/Liquidity/Vol — missing inputs are shown as a white N/A badge instead of being dropped.

default_chart.description: Archived look of the inflation chart before the Shahrivar template (dark base, 12% scale margins, 8-signal library capped at 6).

shahrivar_mobile.description: Shahrivar mobile variant: 6-month window, future margin of 12 bars, four signal badges, 10px font, 1.5px series thickness, compact header and a full-width drawer with 44px touch targets.

shahrivar_tablet.description: Shahrivar tablet variant: 1-year window, six signal badges, 11px font, a 70%-width drawer and 44px touch targets.

shahrivar_desktop.description: Shahrivar desktop variant (default): 3.5-year window, future margin of 24 bars, eight signal badges, 11px font, 2px series thickness and a one-third-width drawer.

shahrivar_ultrawide.description: Shahrivar ultrawide variant: 5-year window, bar spacing of 8, future margin of 32 bars, 12px font and a fixed 22rem drawer for 1920-2559px displays.

shahrivar_tv.description: Shahrivar TV variant (10-foot UI): 1-year window, 16px font and 14px badges, 3px series thickness, future margin of 48 bars, 56px touch targets and reduced motion.
